notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Little Nightmares III" or "Little Nightmares 3". littlenightmares.fandom.com has no page under "Little Nightmares III" but answers under "Little Nightmares 3", with about 61 linked articles, including "Low", "Alone", "The Spiral", "The Necropolis", "The Candy Factory", "The Carnevale" and "The Institute"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Nyx" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1392860. 7 of 44 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the story chapter. The visible achievements have riddle-like descriptions ("Sweets for my sweet", "Nothing left in the medicine cabinet") that do not name a level, so the grouping is a guess from the wording: "Finds and Full Clears" holds the ones whose hints suggest finishing a set, and "Low and Alone Together" the ones about calling on or connecting with your partner (Low and Alone are the names fandom gives the two leads). Unlock rates are very low (most under 5%), so these will need a proper check by a guide writer.
